Info magang dari Kantor Gunawan Gunawan

WE ARE HIRING – INTERNSHIP OPPORTUNITY!

Happy news from @kantorgg (Kantor Gunawan Gunawan)!

Are you a creative mind with a passion for architecture and interior design? We're looking for enthusiastic and talented individuals to join our team as Interns in Architecture & Interior Design!

This is your opportunity to gain hands-on experience, work on exciting projects, learn from experienced professionals, and turn your creative ideas into reality.

What you'll gain:

- Practical experience in real-world projects
- Mentorship and professional guidance
- Opportunities to develop your creative and technical skills
- A collaborative and inspiring work environment

Ready to start your journey with us?

Send your latest CV and portfolio to:

📩 Email: careers@kantorgg.com
📱 WhatsApp (HRD only): +62 851-8689-6844

Subject: Position_Name (e.g. Internship_Architect_YourName)

Or visit our career page:
https://joingggroup.taplink.id/

Come grow, create, and make an impact with us. We can't wait to meet you!
